rationale: PROBE_SCALE sweep at live geometry (2026-07-17): first real test - this mechanism was built 2026-06-23 but never wired into runner.py/promote.py/docker-compose.yml at all (fixed alongside this queue, same 3-layer-gap class partial_tp had). Anti-martingale sizing: enter at reduced probe size, add to full size only if the trade confirms (goes green) within the first few candles. Sidesteps the proven-unsolvable entry-prediction problem by letting the market reveal winners before committing full size.
